inlines.v: IMPAS'SIONED, adjective Actuated or agitated by passion. The tempter all impassioned thus began. 1. Animated; excited; having the feelings warmed; as an impassioned orator. 2. Animated; expressive of passion or ardor; as an impassioned discourse.
